findings.reason: the plan names each symbol beside the range, and every symbol resolves in the current tree with the mechanism it describes, so a builder greps the name and reaches the right code; correcting a drifted line number changes nothing a node does.
findings.text: §1 cites `_pointer_lock` at `reckon/crew/runs.py:549-559` but the function is at `runs.py:291-303`; lines 549-559 hold the unrelated scope-overlap helpers `_scopes_overlap`/`_scope_contains`, and the same staleness appears at `reckon/ledger.py:896-899` (`_run_index_path` is at 901) and `reckon/capabilities.py:1190` (`pick_input_cache_path` is at 1193)

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — the `_pointer_lock` anchor in §1 points past the function it names (and two other line ranges in §1/§2 have drifted), though every named symbol still resolves by name.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §2, §3 and §4 each weigh a measurable assertion against a declared, executed negative control (guard removed → the live index / live run / unpromoted run is touched and the test fails), and §5's measure is a measurable before/after size delta plus `git status` cleanliness; §5 names no negative control but is an operational sweep whose only guard is the listing-before-removal precondition, not a code path a control can falsify.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — every gate writes a test file under `tests/` and §5 captures its report and before/after sizes to "a log under the run directory"; no session-scratchpad or node-local temporary path is named, and §2/§3 assert the real stores are untouched.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag reaches a symbol or filename; the new test files are named by behaviour (`test_gc_bounds_a_run_file.py`, `test_gc_reaches_every_crew_store.py`) and `gc.run_file_max_mb` is a config key, not a deliverable id.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — each §1 root cause matches its cited code (`_run_index_path` keys the index on the resolved ledger path so each checkout rebuilds a full index; retention skips a run directory not in `ledgered`; `_pointer_lock` opens one lock per run and never unlinks it), each section's mechanism can satisfy its own done-when (the head/tail cut with forward newline snaps yields first-and-last-line-intact under limit+marker, and §4 now names the schema regeneration and the forward snap the prior review required), and every mechanism runs through a named caller (`garbage_collect` at `routing.py:1520`, reached by `reckon crew gc`).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §2 bounds one store (ledger indexes), §4 bounds one file class in a promoted run, §5 reclaims one backlog; §3 extends one `gc` mechanism to three stores but carries one deliverable and one gate file, so it closes on one verdict.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan is standalone (plan-standalone meta, no cross-plan depends-on/informs/gates); the intra-plan ordering it needs is declared in prose (§4 "runs after §3, which writes the same module"; §5 "run after §2 to §4 are promoted") and in followup f-tchhab-002, and each section's write paths resolve to real modules.
